title: Research Associate
full_description:
Research Associate - Drug Design (m/w/d)
Silence Therapeutics is an innovative biotechnology company with offices in Berlin, London and New Jersey. Silence develops drugs that use the body's own RNA interference (RNAi) mechanism to specifically deactivate disease-associated genes. Based on its proprietary mRNAi GOLD™ GalNAc Oligonucleotide Discovery) technology, the company develops novel drugs for diseases with high unmet medical needs.
The company's headquarters are located in London, while its research and development departments, including its research laboratories, are based in Berlin. The company currently has around 50 employees at its Berlin-Buch site.
We are seeking a
Technical Assistant or Biological Laboratory Technician (m/f/d)
for a fixed-term position of up to 2 years at our Berlin-Buch location.
In this role, you will work in the Molecular Design Department within the Drug Design team. Together with scientists and other research associates, you will perform experiments supporting the preclinical development of therapeutically active siRNAs. You will analyze and document experimental results and contribute to smooth laboratory operations.
Expected qualification and skills:
Solid experience with cell culture techniques as well as cellular and molecular biology methods (RNA isolation, qPCR)
Very good MS Office skills for data analysis and documentation
High motivation and a structured working style
Strong collaborative skills combined with the ability to work independently
Qualification as BTA, Biological Laboratory Technician (“Biologielaborant”), or B.Sc. in a life science discipline
Good command of German (B2) and English
Preferred qualifications and skills:
Protein analysis techniques (ELISA)
Experience working in 384-well and multiplex formats
Experience in method development
Experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry
Interested candidates are invited to submit their CV and cover letter by 31 March 2026 to our HR department at HR@silence-therapeutics.com.
For more information, please visit www.silence-therapeutics.com.

title: Associate, Payroll Client Services - Sat–Wed
full_description:
About Remote
Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.
With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role.
We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.
If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!
The Position
The Associate, Payroll Client Services provides payroll support and guidance, managing complex multi-country payroll issues and high-volume client inquiries while ensuring compliance and excellent service. The role blends technical payroll expertise with proactive client communication and cross-functional collaboration.
Key Requirements
Experience supporting payroll processing (end-to-end or selected steps) or equivalent support experience.
Solid understanding of payroll fundamentals with working knowledge of regional compliance basics
Experience in client-facing or support roles, with the ability to manage routine inquiries and escalate complex cases when needed.
Strong analytical mindset and attention to detail for reviewing payslips, identifying discrepancies, and supporting issue investigation.
Comfortable working in fast-paced, international environments, with a willingness to learn and adapt.
Strong communication skills: fluent in English, proficient in written and verbal communication, and comfortable using tools such as Slack, Zendesk, and spreadsheets.
Team player who collaborates effectively across departments and contributes to positive team outcomes.
Ability to learn and support multiple payroll-related products, applying product-specific workflows and guidance with support from Specialists (P3).
Key Responsibilities
First-line support: Serve as the initial contact for employee and client inquiries related to payroll, providing clear and timely responses.
Triage incoming support tickets, ensuring accurate routing, prioritization, and timely acknowledgment in alignment with service level agreements (SLAs).
Manage live messaging channels to support employees in real time, escalating issues when necessary.
Multi-product support: Provide frontline support across multiple payroll-related products, following defined procedures and escalating product-specific complexities to Specialists when required.
Regional support: Apply regional payroll requirements independently for standard cases; collaborate with P3 Specialists on complex compliance questions.
Issue handling: Manage routine and moderately complex cases, escalating advanced or high-impact issues to Payroll Specialists or Payroll Operations as appropriate.
Client interaction: Participate in customer calls when support is needed and collaborate with Customer Experience and other teams to deliver a smooth service experience.
Cross-functional collaboration: Work with Payroll Operations, Customer Experience, and other teams to support timely and accurate payroll cycles.
Documentation: Maintain detailed records of inquiries, resolutions, and updates in support tools and contribute to internal knowledge materials.
Continuous improvement: Identify recurring issues and suggest small process enhancements to improve efficiency and reduce escalations.
Practicals
You'll report to: Manager, Payroll Client services
Team: Payroll Client Services
This is a full-time role with a fixed weekly schedule from Saturday through Wednesday. Candidates must be available to work weekends as part of their standard shift.
Location: EMEA
Application process
Interview with recruiter
Interview with future manager
Interview with team members (no managers present)
Bar Raiser Interview
Prior employment verification check
Remote's Total Rewards philosophy is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair equity pay along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. We do not agree to or encourage cheap-labor practices and therefore we ensure to pay above in-location rates. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. Therefore, all compensation changes associated with an internal move will be reviewed by the Total Rewards & People Enablement team on a case by case basis.

$19,650—$44,200 USD
Benefits
Our full benefits & perks are explained in our handbook at remote.com/r/benefits. As a global company, each country works differently, but some benefits/perks are for all Remoters:
work from anywhere
flexible paid time off
flexible working hours (we are async)

mental health support services
stock options
learning budget

How To Apply
Please fill out the form below and upload your CV with a PDF format.

You’ll get to work with client’s C-Level and senior management
You’ll receive targeted training to acquire necessary skills
We have regular all-hands meetings, which provide a mix of learning and socialising for a team of more than 20 motivated consultants
You’ll work in a flexible hybrid office setup between home office, office in Frankfurt, and client’s offices
We offer flexible and fair working hours. We believe that consulting doesn’t mean working 60 hours a week
You’ll get to see many parts of the world and we’ll ensure that your travels and stays are comfortable
We offer a competitive salary and benefits package
What you’ll need to bring
A broad understanding of and interest in the airline and travel industry
A desire to learn and grow together with us in a changing industry and consulting environment due to AI
Undergraduate or master’s degree with 1-2 years of relevant work experience, for example in a consultancy or in a company within the airline or travel industry in a commercial or strategic function
Proficiency in spoken and written English
Knowledge of data analysis and research techniques, including relevant tools (e.g. Google Gemini, Claude or similar LLM,  MS Excel and PowerPoint, Tableau)
Ability and willingness to work in a hybrid setup e.g., work from home, office in Frankfurt and the client’s offices
Ability and willingness to travel globally and frequently for days or potentially up to two weeks at a time. Travel time is expected to be 20% and could be up to 40% of time
Oystin Advisory together with Travel in Motion
Oystin Advisory GmbH and Travel in Motion AG is a partnership of two leading aviation consulting firms. Our focus is on commercial aviation, and within that space, on airline distribution strategies, distribution platforms and technology. We help airlines and IT vendors enhance their distribution capabilities, enable retailing capabilities and understand their customers better. Our key clients are airlines around the globe, from full-service airlines to low-cost carriers, from industry heavyweights to airlines with a fleet of a handful of aircraft.

title: Demand Planning Analyst
full_description:
Job Title: Demand Planning Analyst
Location:
Munich
Department:
Supply Chain
Reports To:
Head of Demand Planning
Job Summary
The Demand Planning Analyst supports the demand planning team by assisting with forecasting, data analysis, and reporting to ensure accurate demand plans. This role is ideal for an early-career professional looking to develop analytical and supply chain planning skills while working closely with cross-functional teams such as sales, marketing, and operations.
Key Responsibilities
Assist in the creation and maintenance of demand forecasts using historical data, trends, and statistical tools
Analyze sales data and identify patterns, risks, and opportunities impacting demand
Support monthly and weekly demand planning cycles and forecast reviews
Prepare reports, dashboards, and KPIs related to forecast accuracy and demand performance
Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Supply Chain teams to gather inputs and assumptions
Help monitor inventory levels and flag potential shortages or excess stock
Maintain planning data in ERP and demand planning systems
Document processes and support continuous improvement initiatives
Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, Business, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field.
Candidates must be based in Munich or open to relocating to Munich from within Germany.
At least 3-5 years of work experience in supply chain, planning, or data analysis in a fast-paced FMCG environment
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, formulas, basic data analysis)
Exposure to ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite) or demand planning tools
Knowledge of basic forecasting methods and KPIs (e.g., forecast accuracy, bias)
Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting tools
Experience in SOP Calendar and submissions.
Business English fluent, knowledge of German is a plus
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
Good communication and collaboration skills
